mapper.select: SELECT product_code AS productCode, product_name AS productName, type, color, category, use_yn AS useYn, price, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY product_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( product_code, product_name, type, color, category, use_yn, price ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{type}, #{color}, #{category}, #{useYn}, #{price} )
